title: Microsoft Teams: new chat sections for muted and meeting chats
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's rollout targets, defaults and lack of tenant controls. One descriptive statement remains unsupported: the sources document dragging sections to reorder them, not dragging chats as described in the risk assessment.

claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn feature page describing the client rollout behaviour was found, apart from the separately acknowledged Graph reference.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Muted chats Meeting chats sections admin controls license Settings chats channels; Teams MutedChats MeetingChats. Opened teamworkSection and reviewed search results; no client-feature behaviour page found.

claims.claim: The Graph teamworkSection reference lists MutedChats and MeetingChats as system-defined section names.
claims.quote:
| MutedChats | The muted chats section. |
| MeetingChats | The meeting chats section. |

claims.claim: The cited teamworkSection documentation describes a beta, non-production API rather than a rollout announcement.
claims.quote: APIs under the `/beta` version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The teamworkSection reference documents operations on an individual user's section list.
claims.quote: Represents a section in a user's Microsoft Teams chat list that organizes chats, channels, and meetings into custom or system-defined groups.

claims.claim: System-defined sections cannot be deleted through this Graph API.
claims.quote: System-defined sections can't be deleted

claims.claim: Only sortType can be updated on a system-defined section through this Graph API.
claims.quote: only the **sortType** property can be updated. Attempts to update other properties or to delete a system-defined section return `403 Forbidden`.

claims.claim: The documented per-user section API is not a tenant switch to enable or disable the sections.
claims.quote: System-defined sections can't be deleted, and only the **sortType** property can be updated.

claims.claim: Chats are moved by the user's own drag and drop.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams organize chat move chats drag drop sections; Teams chat drag sections organize. Read MC1269864, teamworkSection and Learn search excerpts. The notice describes dragging sections; no passage read establishes dragging chats for these sections.
claims.fix: Replace the bullet with: 'No change: chats are grouped automatically according to the muted-chat and meeting-chat rules described above; users can drag and drop the sections to reorder them.' MC1269864 documents section reordering, not moving chats by drag and drop.
